```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
.fmt-outer {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 1em 0;
  border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.fmt-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 36% 1fr;
  background: #5654A2;
  padding: 10px 16px;
}
.fmt-header-cell {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #F8F7F0;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.fmt-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 36% 1fr;
  align-items: stretch;
  border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  background: #F8F7F0;
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}
.fmt-row:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }
.fmt-layer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  background: #EEEDF8;
}
.fmt-row:hover .fmt-layer { background: #E6E5F4; }
.fmt-icon {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #F8F7F0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.fmt-icon svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  color: #5654A2;
  stroke-width: 1.8;
}
.fmt-name {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: #5654A2;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.fmt-resp {
  padding: 12px 20px;
  font-size: 0.95em;
  color: #564232;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
}
.fmt-resp a {
  color: #5654A2;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.fmt-resp a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .fmt-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; justify-items: center; }
  .fmt-header-cell:last-child { display: none; }
  .fmt-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .fmt-layer { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; padding: 10px 14px; }
  .fmt-resp { padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.9em; }
}
</style>

<div class="fmt-outer">
  <div class="fmt-header">
    <div class="fmt-header-cell">Field</div>
    <div class="fmt-header-cell">Value</div>
  </div>
  <div class="fmt-row">
    <div class="fmt-layer">
      <div class="fmt-icon"><i data-lucide="server"></i></div>
      <span class="fmt-name">Server IP</span>
    </div>
    <div class="fmt-resp">172.233.238.100</div>
  </div>
  <div class="fmt-row">
    <div class="fmt-layer">
      <div class="fmt-icon"><i data-lucide="user"></i></div>
      <span class="fmt-name">User Name</span>
    </div>
    <div class="fmt-resp">pingfan</div>
  </div>
  <div class="fmt-row">
    <div class="fmt-layer">
      <div class="fmt-icon"><i data-lucide="lock"></i></div>
      <span class="fmt-name">SQL Database Password</span>
    </div>
    <div class="fmt-resp">0727</div>
  </div>
  <div class="fmt-row">
    <div class="fmt-layer">
      <div class="fmt-icon"><i data-lucide="mail"></i></div>
      <span class="fmt-name">Host Email</span>
    </div>
    <div class="fmt-resp"><a href="mailto:formrcloudgwu@gmail.com">formrcloudgwu@gmail.com</a></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
